description: This file defines a RecyclerView.Adapter named DeviceAdapter used to display and manage a grid of device cards in an Android TV application. It provides focus highlighting, navigation via DPAD, and toggling device states via click and key events.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter
classes.description: Adapter for displaying a grid of device cards with focus and toggle functionality.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter.Device
classes.description: Data class representing a device with id, name, and power state.

classes.name: DeviceAdapter.DeviceVH
classes.description: ViewHolder class holding references to UI components of a device card.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item layout and creates a DeviceVH instance.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds device data to UI components and sets event listeners for focus, click, and key events.

methods.name: applyState
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the device's on/off state.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of devices in the list.
